provenance: Finite authored proposal grammar and separate deterministic evaluation, not a live LLM or customer-discovery trial. A results informed capability availability; fresh selection seed6401 was reserved for B.
shared_evidence: A control team has rights to already validated A,B matrices in the specified dissipative family, needs reproducible disturbance-energy values and may compare controller candidates. Need is a technical use-case hypothesis supported by control literature; purchase intent and workload are not measured.

frozen_evaluation.single_model_energy_audit: Numerical residual-derived trace certificate<=1%; original quality checks, reproducible matrices and explicit model limits; core5s deadline
frozen_evaluation.32_model_interactive_screen: 32 independently certified cases; core0.25s batch deadline; show unsupported cases and fallback costs
frozen_evaluation.8_case_8_gain_design_selection: g in {0,.1,...,.7}; A_g=A-gI; J=trace(X_g)+.15g^2; original problem and constraints preserved. Certified objective interval separation or ordinary-solver refinement, original trace/Frobenius quality requirements, total core deadline2s for8x8 solves. Compare regret against separately computed Schur oracle.
frozen_evaluation.continuous_monitoring_service: Requires streaming prototype, data/fault assurance, observed customer requirement and defensible value hypothesis. Decline when evidence missing; no imaginary human equivalent.

classification: Identical proposals can have different feasibility, but naming the same service differently is never novelty. A service already qualifying for ordinary Beta is improved delivery, not capability-enabled new work. No new-market or sustained-compounding claim is authorized by this finite search.
independence: Separate evaluator code and assistant work roles, not independent organizations or human reviewers. Test generator and oracle are not supplied to production policies.
